svg.title: Tasnim Hassan, data and AI
svg.desc: Tasnim Hassan builds data and AI systems and tests them on real data, with four years on the business side of the numbers. 359,699 live posts streamed through Kafka and Databricks; 13 of 13 private-file reads by an AI skill caught at runtime; 3.5 times fewer reviews per late order caught than random; a 125 million pound plus revenue portfolio reported to a CFO. McGill MMA, Montreal.
